content.title: Instacart and DoorDash Offer Discounts to SNAP Recipients
content.summary: Grocery delivery companies are offering discounts to food-stamp recipients facing reduced and possibly delayed financial assistance in November.  The federal food-assistance program SNAP, which supports about 42 million Americans with roughly $8 billion in benefits each month, is facing a major disruption because of the federal government shutdown.  Federal judges have ordered the Trump administration to tap into contingency funds to keep SNAP benefits flowing.
